texts.setting.pads.about: How many controllers are plugged in. The console has two ports. It is part of the machine: a game is told how many there are, and a movie has columns only for those.
texts.setting.rtc_start.about: The date and time the console's clock shows when the game starts, in seconds since 1970. For example 1262304000 is 2010-01-01, in the years the Zeebo was sold. It cannot be earlier than 1980-01-06, which is the date the console's system counts from. After the start the clock runs with the game and never with your computer. It is part of the machine: a game that picks its random numbers from the time plays differently with another date.
texts.slot.game.help: The game as it was dumped from a console: a .7z or .zip archive with a 'mif' folder and a 'mod' folder in it, or the game's .mod file. Zeebx's compatibility list (github.com/ZeebxTeam/zeebx-emu, COMPATIBILIDADE.md) says which games work.
texts.slot.savedata.help: What the game already saved, as Emulator > Export Save Data... wrote it. It is a .zip of the console's saves folder, and it is put back before the game starts.
